An alias under no parameters and its target have the same module part at every substitution, both ways: the alias denotes the module part of what its target denotes (udenote_alias).
Lemma same_part_alias_nil : forall Γ E,
    same_part Γ (me_lit (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))) E /\ same_part Γ E (me_lit (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))).
Proof.
  intros Γ E; split; intros Γ1 ζ R0 Rm Hζ Hm HRm;
    cbn [modexp_sub] in *; rewrite gunit_sub_mk in *; cbn [tele_sub moddef_sub sb_qn List.length] in *.
  - apply mdenote_lit_inv in Hm; inversion Hm; subst.
    rewrite mdesc_up_nil in HRm.
    match goal with Hmd : mdesc_mod ?R = Some ?R', HE : mdenote _ _ _ _ ?R |- _ =>
      rewrite (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ Hmd)) in HRm; injection HRm as <-;
      exists R; split; [ exact HE | exact Hmd ] end.
  - exists Rm; split; [| exact (mdesc_is_mod_mod _ (mdesc_mod_is_mod _ _ HRm)) ].
    apply mdenote_lit; rewrite <- (mdesc_up_nil Rm); econstructor; [ exact Hm | exact HRm ].
Qed.

An alias under no parameters, its target glued, is glued as its target: its value is the target's (eval_close_alias0), and it has the target's module part (same_part_alias_nil), neither naming an open frame (names_no_frame_of_frame_free).
Lemma glu_lit_alias_modexp_at : forall Γ E,
    gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk nil (md_alias E) ≈ gu_mk nil (md_alias E) ->
    glu_modexp_at Γ E ->
    glu_modexp_at Γ (me_lit (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))).
Proof.
  intros * HU HE Sb HSb Δ σ ρ Hσ.
  destruct (HE _ HSb _ _ _ Hσ) as (h & Eh & Hg).
  exists h; split; [ apply eval_me_lit_iff; constructor; exact Eh |].
  destruct (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ HU)) as [_ _ _ _ _ HEt _ _ _ _ Hff]; cbn [List.app] in HEt, Hff.
  destruct (same_part_alias_nil Γ E) as [Hs01 Hs10].
  eapply (proj1 glu_dmod_same_part);
    [ exact Hg | apply wf_me_beta_alias0; [ exact HEt | exact Hff ] | exact Hs01 | exact Hs10
    | intros; apply names_no_frame_of_none; reflexivity
    | intros; eapply names_no_frame_of_frame_free; eassumption ].
Qed.

A literal body lacking the parameters Δr: saturated, it is glued as a body (glu_lit_body_modexp_at).
Lemma glu_lit_open_params : forall Δr Δa Γ Φ,
    unit_full gc_deps gc_stack Γ (gu_open (Δr ++ Δa) Φ) ->
    ⊩ (body_ctx (gm_expand Φ) ++ Δr ++ Δa ++ Γ) ->
    glu_modexp_at (Δa ++ Γ) (me_lit (gu_open Δr Φ)).
Proof.
  intros * Hf HC.
  apply glu_lit_open_params_gen; [ reflexivity | exact Hf | exact (glu_rel_ctx_app_r _ _ HC) |].
  pose proof (unit_eq_of_full _ _ _ _ (unit_full_unabs _ _ _ (Δr ++ Δa) nil _ Hf)) as HU.
  rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HU.
  exact (glu_lit_body_modexp_at _ _ HU HC (body_sorts_typed_of_unit _ _ HU)).
Qed.

An extension glued at every renaming of a glued context is glued over it: at the identity.
Lemma glu_rel_ext_under_renaming_here : forall Γ Ψ, ⊩ Γ -> glu_rel_ext_under_renaming Γ Ψ -> ⊩ (Ψ ++ Γ).
Proof.
  intros * HΓ HΨ.
  assert (HwΓ : ⊢ Γ) by (destruct HΓ as [Sb HSb]; exact (glu_ctx_env_wf_ctx HSb)).
  pose proof (HΨ _ _ (wf_wk_id _ _ _ HwΓ) HΓ) as H.
  pose proof (gunit_wk_id (gu_mk Ψ (md_alias (me_var 0)))) as E; rewrite gunit_wk_mk in E; injection E as E _.
  rewrite E in H; exact H.
Qed.

The closure of a well-formed unit glued at a glued context, at a glued environment, is glued as the unit's literal: a body's by its body context's gluing (glu_lit_open_params), an alias's by its target's (glu_lit_alias_modexp_at), each lacking the unit's parameters (glu_lit_open_params_gen).
Lemma glu_unit_modexp_at : forall Γ U,
    gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U -> ⊩ Γ -> glu_unit_at Γ U -> glu_modexp_at Γ (me_lit U).
Proof.
  intros Γ [Δu [sm Φ | E]] HU HΓ Hg; pose proof (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ HU)) as Hf; cbn [glu_unit_at] in Hg.
  - destruct sm; cbn [unit_full] in Hf; [| contradiction ].
    destruct Hg as [HB _].
    pose proof (glu_rel_ext_under_renaming_here _ _ HΓ HB) as HC; rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HC.
    pose proof (glu_lit_open_params Δu nil Γ Φ) as H; rewrite List.app_nil_r in H; cbn [List.app] in H.
    exact (H (proj1 (unit_full_of_eq _ _ _ _ _ HU)) HC).
  - destruct Hg as [HΔ HE].
    pose proof (glu_rel_ext_under_renaming_here _ _ HΓ HΔ) as HC.
    pose proof (unit_eq_of_full _ _ _ _ (unit_full_unabs _ _ _ Δu nil _ Hf)) as HU0.
    apply (glu_lit_open_params_gen (md_alias E) I Δu nil Γ); rewrite ?List.app_nil_r;
      [ exact Hf | exact HC | exact (glu_lit_alias_modexp_at _ _ HU0 HE) ].
Qed.

The Value of a Module Slot

The innermost slot's value, glued as its unit's literal over the context before it, is glued as the slot: read through the shift (glu_dmod_through), the literal weakened denotes as the slot (same_denote_slot).
Lemma glu_dmod_head_slot : forall e Γ U Δ σ h,
    (e :: Γ) ∋ #0 ≔ₘ gunit_wk U wk_shift -> Δ ⊢ˢ σ : e :: Γ ->
    glu_dmod Δ (Wk ⨟ σ) Γ (me_lit U) h -> glu_dmod Δ σ (e :: Γ) (me_var 0) h.
Proof.
  intros * Hy Hσ Hg.
  pose proof (wf_sub_cod _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hw.
  assert (HWk : e :: Γ ⊢ˢ Wk : Γ) by (apply wf_sub_shift; exact Hw).
  pose proof (proj1 glu_dmod_through _ _ _ _ _ Hg _ _ _ HWk Hσ ltac:(apply wf_sub_eq_refl; eapply wf_sub_compose; eassumption)) as Hg1.
  assert (E : (me_lit U)[Wk]ᵐ = me_lit (gunit_wk U wk_shift)) by (rewrite <- gunit_sub_of_wk; reflexivity).
  rewrite E in Hg1.
  destruct (same_denote_slot Hy) as [Hd01 Hd10].
  eapply (proj1 glu_dmod_same_part);
    [ exact Hg1 | eapply wf_me_delta_slot; eassumption | exact (same_part_of_denote Hd01) | exact (same_part_of_denote Hd10)
    | intros; apply names_no_frame_of_none; eapply mod_qname_sub_var; eassumption
    | intros; apply names_no_frame_of_none; apply mod_qname_sub_lit ].
Qed.

A module slot's value in a glued environment is glued as the slot: the innermost by the slot's clause of the context gluing, a deeper one by the tail's, read through the shift.
Lemma glu_dmod_slot : forall Γ y U, Γ ∋ #y ≔ₘ U -> forall Sb, EG Γ ∈ glu_ctx_env ↘ Sb ->
    forall Δ σ ρ, Δ ⊢ˢ σ ® ρ ∈ Sb -> glu_dmod Δ σ Γ (me_var y) (env_mod ρ y).
Proof.
  induction 1 as [U0 Γ0 | A0 M0 U0 Γ0 | n U0 Γ0 e Hn IH]; intros Sb HSb Δ σ ρ Hσ.
  - inversion HSb; subst.
    match goal with HE : Sb <∙> cons_mod_glu_sub_pred _ _ _ |- _ => apply HE in Hσ end.
    destruct Hσ as [? ? ? Hσt _ Hg _ _ _].
    eapply glu_dmod_head_slot; [ constructor | exact Hσt | exact Hg ].
  - inversion HSb; subst.
    match goal with HE : Sb <∙> cons_dm_glu_sub_pred _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => apply HE in Hσ end.
    destruct Hσ as [? ? ? ? P El Hσt _ _ _ _ _ Hg _ _ _].
    eapply glu_dmod_head_slot; [ constructor | exact Hσt | exact Hg ].
  - destruct (glu_rel_ctx_tail (ex_intro _ _ HSb)) as [TSb HTSb].
    pose proof (glu_ctx_env_sub_tail HSb HTSb Hσ) as Hσ'.
    pose proof (IH _ HTSb _ _ _ Hσ') as Hg.
    pose proof (glu_ctx_env_sub_escape HSb _ _ _ Hσ) as Hσt.
    assert (HWk : e :: Γ0 ⊢ˢ Wk : Γ0) by (apply wf_sub_shift; exact (wf_sub_cod _ _ _ _ _ Hσt)).
    exact (proj1 glu_dmod_through _ _ _ _ _ Hg _ _ _ HWk Hσt ltac:(apply wf_sub_eq_refl; eapply wf_sub_compose; eassumption)).
Qed.

The identity factorization of a typed substitution.
Lemma glu_sub_through_id : forall Δ σ Γ, Δ ⊢ˢ σ : Γ -> glu_sub_through Δ σ Γ Δ wk_id Γ Id σ.
Proof.
  intros * Hσ.
  constructor; [ apply kripke_id; exact (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) | apply wf_sub_id; exact (wf_sub_cod _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) | exact Hσ |].
  apply wf_sub_eq_of_sb_eq; [ exact (wf_sub_sb_wk Hσ (kripke_id _ (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hσ))) |].
  rewrite sb_compose_id_left; intros n; unfold sb_wk; destruct (σ n); cbn;
    [ reflexivity | rewrite exp_wk_id | rewrite modexp_wk_id | rewrite exp_wk_id, modexp_wk_id ]; reflexivity.
Qed.

The Members of a Saturated Body Value

A proof of a body related to another, its type at the environment of the entries before it: a proposition, by the kind its definition is tagged with (per_body_def).
Lemma per_body_proof_kind : forall Φ ρ ρ' Φ2, per_body ρ Φ ρ' Φ2 ->
    forall x Φ1 b pv A M, gm_prefix_upto Φ x = Some (gm_ext Φ1 x (ge_def b pv ak_propositional A (Some M))) ->
    exists ρ1 a, ⟦ Φ1 ⟧ᵇ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ ρ1 /\ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ1 ↘ a /\ domain_kind a = ak_propositional.
Proof.
  induction Φ as [| Φ IH y E | Φ IH H its Φg _]; intros * Hb * Hp; cbn in Hp; [ discriminate | |].
  - destruct (String.eqb x y) eqn:Exy.
    + injection Hp as <- <-; inversion Hb; subst;
        match goal with H2 : _ = ge_def _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => try discriminate H2; injection H2 as -> -> -> -> -> end.
      match goal with Hk : rel_typ_kind _ _ _, Hb0 : ⟦ _ ⟧ᵇ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ρ ↘ ?ρ0 |- _ =>
        destruct Hk as (a0 & Ea0 & Ka0); exists ρ0, a0; repeat split; assumption end.
    + inversion Hb; subst; eapply IH; eassumption.
  - inversion Hb.
Qed.

The member of a saturated body value glued as H, at a type value of an evaluated kind related to the member types of the value (dmod_mem_type_rel), is glued as the member there: glued at the entry's own type value through the identity factorization, moved to the related one (glu_univ_elem_exp_conv_universe_index). A proof is no such member: its type is a proposition (per_body_proof_kind).
Lemma glu_mem_body_value : forall Δ σ Γ H sm Φ ρh x R A Srt m a2 (k : nat) P2 El2,
    glu_dmod Δ σ Γ H (dm_local nil (md_body sm Φ) ρh) ->
    mdenote gc_deps gc_stack Γ (me_mem H x) R -> mdesc_type R = Some A -> type_sort Srt -> Γ ⊢ A : Srt ->
    dm_local nil (md_body sm Φ) ρh ·ₜ x gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ m ->
    per_dmod (dm_local nil (md_body sm Φ) ρh) (dm_local nil (md_body sm Φ) ρh) ->
    dmod_mem_type_rel (dm_local nil (md_body sm Φ) ρh) x a2 ->
    evaluated_kind (domain_kind a2) ->
    DG a2 ∈ glu_univ_elem k ↘ P2 ↘ El2 -> Δ ⊢ A[σ] ® P2 ->
    Δ ⊢ (a_mem H x)[σ] : A[σ] ® m ∈ El2.
Proof.
  intros * Hg Hm HA HS HAt Hsel Hhh Hty Hev Hg2 HP2.
  inversion Hg; subst;
    [| exfalso; match goal with Hn : next_param (dm_local nil _ _) _ |- _ => inversion Hn; subst end;
       match goal with Hl : _ ++ _ :: nil = nil |- _ => destruct Δ0; discriminate end ].
  match goal with Hσ0 : Δ ⊢ˢ σ : Γ, Hmem0 : forall (x0 : String.string) _ _ _ _ _, _ -> _ -> _ -> _ -> exists _ _, glu_body_member _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
    rename Hσ0 into Hσ, Hmem0 into Hmem end.
  inversion Hhh; subst;
    [| exfalso; match goal with Hn : next_param (dm_local nil _ _) _ |- _ => inversion Hn; subst end;
       match goal with Hl : _ ++ _ :: nil = nil |- _ => destruct Δ0; discriminate end ].
  match goal with Hb : per_body ρh Φ ρh Φ |- _ => rename Hb into Hbb end.
  pose proof (proj1 (KindsPER.per_body_noopen _ _ _ _ Hbb)) as Hno.
  inversion Hsel; subst.
  - match goal with Hl : 0 < length nil |- _ => inversion Hl end.
  -
A definition of an evaluated kind
    destruct (Hmem _ _ _ _ _ _ H3 H4 H5 H8) as (a & m' & [Ea Em Hfield]).
    pose proof (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ Em H10) as ->.
    pose proof (dmod_mem_type_body sm Φ ρh x _ _ _ _ _ _ H3 H4 H8 Ea) as Hmt.
    destruct (Hty _ _ Hhh Hmt) as [j Hj].
    pose proof (wf_sub_cod _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as HwΓ.
    assert (Hst : glu_sub_through Δ σ Γ Δ wk_id Γ Id σ).
    { constructor; [ apply kripke_id; exact (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) | apply wf_sub_id; exact HwΓ | exact Hσ |].
      apply wf_sub_eq_of_sb_eq; [ exact (wf_sub_sb_wk Hσ (kripke_id _ (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hσ))) |].
      rewrite sb_compose_id_left; intros n; unfold sb_wk; destruct (σ n); cbn;
        [ reflexivity | rewrite exp_wk_id | rewrite modexp_wk_id | rewrite exp_wk_id, modexp_wk_id ]; reflexivity. }
    rewrite <- (modexp_sub_id H) in Hm.
    destruct (Hfield _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hst Hm HA HS HAt) as (i & P & El & [Hga HAP HMm]).
    rewrite !modexp_sub_id in HMm.
    exact (glu_univ_elem_exp_conv_universe_index (i := ul i) (j := ul k) Hj Hga Hg2 HMm HP2).
  -
A proof: its type is a proposition, not of the evaluated kind of the member's type
    exfalso.
    match goal with Hp : gm_prefix_upto _ x = Some (gm_ext ?Φ1 x ?E), Ht : entry_tm ?E = Some _, Hk : entry_kind ?E = ak_propositional |- _ =>
      rename Hp into Hp0, Ht into Ht0, Hk into Hk0 end.
    destruct E as [b pv κ A1 [M1 |] | | | | ]; cbn in Ht0, Hk0; try discriminate; injection Ht0 as <- <-; subst κ.
    pose proof Hp0 as Hp'; rewrite (gm_expand_noopen _ Hno) in Hp'.
    destruct (per_body_proof_kind _ _ _ _ Hbb _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp') as (ρ1 & b0 & Hb1 & Eb0 & Kb0).
    destruct (Hty _ _ Hhh (dmod_mem_type_body _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp0 eq_refl Hb1 Eb0)) as [j [Rj Hj]].
    rewrite <- (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ Hj), Kb0 in Hev; inversion Hev.
Qed.

A module slot is glued in a glued context.
Lemma glu_slot_modexp_at : forall Γ y U, Γ ∋ #y ≔ₘ U -> glu_modexp_at Γ (me_var y).
Proof.
  intros * Hy Sb HSb Δ σ ρ Hσ.
  exists (env_mod ρ y); split; [ constructor | exact (glu_dmod_slot _ _ _ Hy _ HSb _ _ _ Hσ) ].
Qed.
